harness.name: deepseek-harness
harness.note: Local workbench runs on the 0.1.2-alpha.5 harness source tree. Community plugins authored against the 0.1.2-rc.1 surface run here on the alpha peer surface, so the pinned @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools must stay on this same alpha line.

@deepseek-ai/cordis.requirement: resolved to the running host harness instance (peer dependency of every Helmsman package; never bundled as a private copy)
@deepseek-ai/cordis.note: Peer/API compatibility surface shared by Helmsman and community plugins.

@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.note: MUST stay pinned to the 0.1.2-alpha.5 line (pnpm.overrides in the profile package.json). Bumping to the rc line breaks CallId/ToolCallId imports; see knownIssues[0].

community.note: Reused lazily by @helmsman/worktree (graceful degradation when absent). README quick-start installs the GitHub default; 1.2.2 is the version audited in docs/SECURITY-AUDIT.md §2.1 and therefore the verified pin.

community.name: dsh-memory-manager
community.note: Reused by @helmsman/memory-topology (best-effort mirror). Version pinned by the README quick-start tgz URL; v1.3.3 exists but requires a re-audit before upgrade.

community.name: dsh-memory-palace
community.note: Used through agent tools only, per its design. README quick-start installs the GitHub default; 1.6.2-alpha.4 is the version audited in docs/SECURITY-AUDIT.md §2.3 and therefore the verified pin.

knownIssues.detail: The 0.1.2-rc.8 line of @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools imports the legacy CallId export from @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm, which the alpha line renamed to ToolCallId. A dsh-tools on the rc line running against the 0.1.2-alpha.5 harness makes plugins importing the shared call-id type fail at module load.
knownIssues.symptom: @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm does not provide an export named 'CallId'
knownIssues.resolution: Keep @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools pinned to 0.1.2-alpha.5 (pnpm.overrides in the profile package.json). Do not move to the rc line without re-verifying the affected imports.
